enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Adjust pillow. Turn to back. Move legs. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Snore. Shift body position. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Pull blanket up. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at bathroom. Turn on light. Close door. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower lid. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into sink. Wipe mouth with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Place bowl on counter. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Open drawer. Take out spoon. Close drawer. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Place bowl and spoon in sink. Turn on tap. Rinse bowl and spoon. Turn off tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Lay clothes on bed. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Pick up bag. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

Leave house. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Wait for bus. See bus arrive. Board bus. Insert card into fare box. Find seat. Sit on seat. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Greet colleagues. Go to locker room. Change into scrubs. Wash hands. Pick up stethoscope. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check patient's vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Listen to lungs. Administer medication. Record notes. Walk to nurses' station. Review patient charts. Discuss with doctor. Update patient records. Take lunch break. Return to work. Attend meeting.

Leave workplace. Say goodbye to colleagues. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Wait for bus. See bus arrive. Board bus. Insert card into fare box. Find seat. Sit on seat. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk home. Open door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Place ingredients on counter. Open cabinet. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Add meat. Stir with spatula. Add spices. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink. Rinse plate. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

Enter living room. Turn on light. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select show. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue watching TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Eat snack. Watch TV.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Close door. Remove clothes. Place clothes in hamper. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply shampoo to hair. Lather hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and relaxing, using phone due to power outage from storm
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Pick up phone. Check phone. Turn on phone flashlight. Continue reading. Put down book. Pick up phone. Browse social media. Read messages. Reply to messages. Put down phone. Pick up book. Read more.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Close door. Remove clothes. Fold clothes. Place clothes on chair. Open drawer. Take out pajamas. Put on pajamas. Pick up phone. Check messages. Set alarm. Put phone on nightstand. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn off light. Pull back blanket. Lie in bed. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Adjust pillow. Turn to back. Move legs. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Snore. Shift body position. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Pull blanket up. Remain asleep.
